desc: Ideation: SCC/cycle compression on functional graph, forest DP with prefix sums, O(N*M), product over cycle-root components
Verify DP direction on samples 1 and 2 (child <= parent; answer = product over cycle components of sum_t f(t))

Implement the full solution: parse input, build children adjacency from A, run Kahn-style in-degree elimination computing per-node prefix-sum arrays, then group remaining cycle nodes, compute each cycle component's array, multiply answer by sum over t for each component, output mod 998244353.

Review implemented code for correctness: self-loops (A_i==i as 1-cycles), cycle-internal edges excluded from children, memory cleanup of child arrays, modular arithmetic, and edge cases (N=1, M=1, single long cycle, chain into self-loop).
